rule.statement: A canonical G5 gets the finite natural sources that its place family allows on common land and that its G4 natural-material profile lists; yards and household plots get none unless a parcel right says so.
rule.g4_profile_evidence: ref-gamebase natural_materials_soils/g4_ground_and_materials.csv rows nmg4_vikhtuy_locality__deadwood (rare) and __driftwood (rare); finite_source_profiles_ext.json is a candidate, approved=false, not runtime authority

excluded_place_families.pf_rural_yard: parcel right only (unknown is not permission)
excluded_place_families.pf_peasant_homestead: parcel right only (unknown is not permission)
excluded_place_families.pf_outbuildings: parcel right only (unknown is not permission)

rule.not_covered_by_rule: reeds and standing wood: the G4 profile lists no reed for vikhtuy_locality and cutting needs a tool the code does not check (LW)

open_questions_for_approver: Quantities come from the approved m2c-items profiles (deadwood 60, driftwood 100); the G4 candidate says rare (about 25). Keep the profile numbers or cap them?
Place-family mapping of the eight Vikhtuy canonical G5 is taken from m2c-npc-wave/v1/datasets/spatial_node_place_family_bindings.json.
Access: the approved gameplay_access_policy (free gathering) applies to these commons; the property-context file excludes canonical G5, so no explicit parcel rule exists for them.
